subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses progress mode to a compact summary after final delivery, and the requested behavior adds a new public config and checklist presentation contract rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep current collapse summary
options.body: Leave Telegram progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this as a broader cross-channel progress-card design so checklist state can be modeled consistently instead of adding a Telegram-only shape now.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has the most targeted recent commit on the Telegram collapse-bar fallback path that this policy would extend.
